title: SimulationRun
description: Schema for a single simulation run result, including provenance data required for Constitution Principle VI.

network_id.description: Unique identifier for the network graph used in this run.

seed.description: The random seed used for this specific simulation run.

diffusion_rate.description: Calculated rate of energy diffusion (spatial variance change) over the simulation steps.

topology_class.description: The class of network topology generated.

steps_run.description: Number of simulation time steps executed.

runtime_duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock execution time in seconds, measured by T026b/T028.

generation_algorithm.description: Name of the algorithm used to generate the graph (e.g., 'erdos_renyi', 'watts_strogatz').

parameter_values.description: Dictionary of parameters used during graph generation, sourced from T019 metadata.
